# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# CMake configuration file
# Automatically generated by pymake, a script developed by VCOliver
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25.1)
project(tetris VERSION 0.0.10 LANGUAGES CXX)

# Set the C++ standard
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS ON)

# Ensure a default build type if not specified
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

message(STATUS "Build type: ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")

# Supported build types
set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "Debug;Release" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

# Set additional flags for Debug build
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG} -g -O0")

# Set output directories for binaries and libraries
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/release)
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/release/lib)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/debug)
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/debug/lib)

# Include directories
include_directories(include)
include_directories(assets)

# Find SDL2 package
find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)
find_package(SDL2_ttf REQUIRED)

# Source files
set(SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/core/game.cpp
    src/core/window.cpp
    src/core/log.cpp
    src/components/renderComponents.cpp
    src/systems/renderSystem.cpp
    src/systems/fontSystem.cpp
    src/systems/physicsSystem.cpp
    src/utils/position.cpp
    src/utils/colors.cpp
    src/utils/mathUtils.cpp
    src/utils/shapes.cpp
    src/entities/tetrion.cpp
    src/entities/tetrominos.cpp
    src/entities/stopwatch.cpp
    src/entities/score.cpp
    src/entities/playfield.cpp
    src/input/inputManager.cpp
    src/input/inputMapping.cpp
    src/events/event.cpp
    src/events/collisionEvent.cpp
)

# Add the executables
add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} ${SOURCES})

# Conditionally define DEBUG_LOGGING for Debug builds
target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:DEBUG_LOGGING>
)

# Include SDL2 headers
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${SDL2TTF_INCLUDE_DIRS})

# Link SDL2 library
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ${SDL2_LIBRARIES} SDL2_ttf)

# Add precompiled headers
target_precompile_headers(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE include/pch.h)

# Define output directories for debug and release builds
set(COPY_DEST_DEBUG ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/debug/assets)
set(COPY_DEST_RELEASE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/release/assets)

# Copy assets folder after build
add_custom_command(
    TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory 
            $<IF:$<CONFIG:Debug>,${COPY_DEST_DEBUG},${COPY_DEST_RELEASE}>
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
            ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets
            $<IF:$<CONFIG:Debug>,${COPY_DEST_DEBUG},${COPY_DEST_RELEASE}>
)
